title: Prophetic Advice to Ibn Abbas
summary: Prophet Muhammad advised Ibn Abbas on reliance on Allah and fate.
translation: Abdullah ibn Abbas narrated that one day I was riding behind the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him), and he said to me, 'O young boy, I shall teach you some words: Guard the commandments of Allah, and He will guard you. Preserve His rights, and you will find Him before you. If you ask, ask from Allah; if you seek help, seek help from Allah. Know that if the entire world gathers to benefit you, they cannot benefit except what Allah has decreed for you, and if they gather to harm you, they cannot harm except what Allah has written for you. The pens have been lifted, and the pages have dried.' In some versions beyond Tirmidhi, it is noted: 'Preserve Allah's commands in prosperity, He will preserve you in adversity. Know that what missed you was never meant to reach you, and what afflicted you was never meant to pass you. Be aware that patience is the key with which Allah's help comes, and ease follows hardship.' In this beautiful hadith, we are reminded that placing our focus on Allah leads to His support in all matters, for while people dislike being asked, Allah is displeased when not asked. As the Quran commands, 'Call upon Me; I will respond to you.' This is why Shaykh Abdul Qadir Jilani advises the believers to adhere to this hadith in all actions for achieving divine mercy and elevation in both worlds.
